title: vernonia cinerea var. parviflora
intro: Vernonia cinerea var. parviflora, commonly known as the small-flowered ironweed, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Vernonia cinerea var. parviflora include its ability to act as an antimicrobial, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
